summary_en: This Phase III study compares rilvegostomig with pembrolizumab, each given alone as first-line treatment, in people with PD-L1-high metastatic non-small cell lung cancer. Both drugs are given by intravenous infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle, and the total duration is not stated. The study's stated purpose is to assess efficacy and safety; a specific primary outcome is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase III compara rilvegostomig con pembrolizumab, administrados cada uno por separado como tratamiento de primera línea, en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas metastásico con PD-L1 alto. Ambos medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y la duración total no se indica. El objetivo declarado del estudio es evaluar la eficacia y la seguridad; no se indica un resultado principal específico.
who_for: Stage IV non-small cell lung cancer not amenable to curative treatment.
No sensitizing EGFR mutations and no ALK or ROS1 rearrangements.
WHO/ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 without recent decline.
Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
At least one measurable lesion not previously irradiated.
not_for: Small cell or neuroendocrine histology components.
Any prior systemic therapy for advanced or metastatic lung cancer.
Any prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti-TIGIT therapy.
Brain metastases unless asymptomatic and stable without steroids or anticonvulsants for 4 weeks.
Autoimmune or inflammatory disorder needing chronic steroids or immunosuppressive treatment, or a history of organ transplant.
